newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain tradeless in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain tradeless in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market remained tradeless this afternoon despite a further rise in Chicago soymeal futures this afternoon, market sources said.
"The rise in Chicago is technical and dealers here refuse to buy that. A stronger dollar also kept a lid on business ahead of the weekend," one broker said.

Sellers were offering South American soymeal pellets today $7 to $10 up, which discouraged most buyers from entering the market which was already calm for days due to a lack of faith. --KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
